item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Azure introduced Standard service endpoint as a generally available capability in the Azure Private Link family. It is designed to provide a scalable, secure way to connect Azure IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services, addressing manageability and scale limitations.

  • Source: Azure Updates
